requirements.name: Continuous zoom pan rotate with keyboard alternatives
requirements.gap: B1.8 provides keyboard/pointer interaction on a raster image. F3 provides the governed OpenSeadragon deep-zoom foundation and the managed build now prepares complete DZI assets, but the final professional client interaction layer is not yet integrated.

requirements.name: Drawing-first visual hierarchy
requirements.gap: The audited B1.8 surface still places governance/provenance content and forms before sustained engineering drawing work. The kernel and asset foundations deliberately do not claim UI completion.

requirements.name: True technical vector representation from governed document geometry
requirements.gap: The projection kernel has a normalized scene envelope and reuses F6 structural projections, but current runtime scenes do not yet materialize Dual Vector Agreement document primitives/text into the technical scene.

requirements.name: Selectable technical objects and hit testing
requirements.gap: F6 has selectable SVG members and the kernel has stable typed scene object ids, but the new professional client/hit-testing layer is not yet integrated.

requirements.name: Object-anchored editable recognized text and values
requirements.gap: WorkingEdit is a validated object-bound non-canonical delta that preserves its base value and rejects governed structural targets. RecognizedText/Dimension objects and their in-place UI are not yet materialized in the live workbench.

requirements.name: Provenance-backed source-to-technical registration transform
requirements.gap: RegistrationTransform has explicit coordinate spaces, states, revision binding, control-correspondence requirements and fail-closed validation. The real project still has no VERIFIED source-to-technical registration, so spatial synchronization remains unavailable.

requirements.name: Synchronized split navigation guarded by valid registration
requirements.gap: Semantic synchronization remains available through explicit EvidenceLink/F6 relations. The kernel rejects SPATIAL_LOCKED unless registration is VERIFIED and revision-matched; the actual synchronized multi-viewport client is still pending.

requirements.name: Overlay comparison mode with opacity/alignment controls
requirements.gap: The kernel fail-closes an OVERLAY request without verified registration, but no registered overlay renderer/client controls are implemented.

requirements.name: Layer-capable technical scene
requirements.gap: A typed scene envelope and layer vocabulary exist, but Dual Vector Agreement primitives, recognized text/dimensions, issues and working-edit visual deltas are not yet composed into one rendered layer stack.

requirements.name: Graphically anchored ReadingIssue workflow
requirements.gap: ReadingIssue requires an object, non-viewport geometry, or explicit EvidenceLink anchor and cannot authorize canonical write. Graphical markers, issue list and inspector workflow remain to be implemented in the client.

requirements.name: Progressive disclosure Work -> Evidence -> Provenance
requirements.gap: The design contract is versioned, but the audited live surface still exposes internal provenance/governance directly in the primary workspace.

requirements.name: Multiresolution or tiled large-drawing rendering architecture
requirements.gap: The managed-runtime build/serving contract generates all four declared F3 DZI pyramids, binds them to exact runtime revision and serves them behind auth without dynamic PDF rasterization. A real Render build/live asset smoke and final client consumption remain required.

requirements.name: Dedicated maintainable workbench client/state architecture
requirements.gap: A dedicated deterministic kernel owns scene validation, view-state resolution, registration guards, WorkingEdit, ReadingIssue and revision-bound view state, with a non-canonical runtime API. The final typed browser client/event/state implementation is still pending.

requirements.name: Desktop-first engineering layout with tablet/narrow review modes
requirements.gap: Device-mode behavior is explicitly designed, but no final professional client implements those state maps.

requirements.name: Saved/reusable professional view state
requirements.gap: A revision-bound ViewSnapshot stores display/sync mode, active layers, source/technical viewport state and selection while explicitly remaining non-canonical; persistence/reload UX and durable storage are not yet integrated.

requirements.name: Professional engineering-task HVA protocol
requirements.gap: The professional find-orient-compare-identify-edit-verify-resolve protocol is versioned but intentionally not executable until implementation entry criteria are satisfied.
